adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, team destination calendars are collected only when `user.destinationCalendar` exists (`if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE" && user.destinationCalendar) { teamDestinationCalendars.push(...) }`), and later only these are appended to `evt.destinationCalendar`. EventManager’s `createAllCalendarEvents` now creates calendar events only for entries present in `event.destinationCalendar` (iterating that array when non-empty) and does not have any mechanism to “also create for other hosts” who were not included. So collective hosts without `user.destinationCalendar` will not receive a created calendar event under this new multi-destination approach. Whether that is a strict bug depends on product expectations, but the edge-case/incompleteness is real and diff-grounded.
